name: Pulsar Sphere-based Neural Rendering
definition: Pulsar is an efficient sphere-based differentiable renderer that maps a 3D sphere-based scene representation S to a rendered feature image F based on camera parameters (rotation R, translation t, intrinsic K). It enables real-time rendering and optimization of representations with millions of spheres by limiting complexity in the projection step.
summary: Pulsar Sphere-based Neural Rendering is an efficient, sphere-based differentiable renderer that avoids mesh and voxel inconsistencies by using sparse spheres and pixel-parallelization for fast, end-to-end scene optimization.
